name: Laboratory Fixed Resistor & Carbon Film Spiral
semanticDescription: Laboratory fixed resistor mounted on a slate carrier plinth with dual knurled brass binding posts. Features a ceramic body with standard 4-band EIA color rings (1.0 k-ohm +/-5%), paired with an internal longitudinal cutaway revealing the alumina ceramic core, laser-grooved helical carbon film spiral, and resistance formula (R = rho * l / A) for CBSE Class 10 and 12 physics.
